title: Support MG loosens on a long burst
why: His order: the Support MG should get marginally less accurate the longer it fires without a break. Unbroken fire heats it over 4.5 seconds, up to 30 percent wider spread on top of the bloom, the cursor ring opens with it, and it is back to normal about a second after the trigger is let go. The spin-up is unchanged.
now: The Support MG gets a little less accurate the longer you hold the trigger, and tightens again a second after you let go.

edits.replacement: tgt=base+BLM_UNITS*(p.bloomK||0)+LMG_HEAT_RING*lmgHeatF(p); b0=p.bloom||0;   // v28.xx (cw-lmgbloom): the ring shows the heat

if(fromPlayer&&gunBase(wep.id)==='smg'&&G.player.fireHold) spx*=Math.min(1.9,1+G.player.fireHold*0.45);
  if(fromPlayer) spx*=lmgHeatMul(G.player,wep);   // v28.xx (cw-lmgbloom), HIS ORDER (2026-10-18): "lmg should get marginally less accurate the longer player fires it continuously"
